name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME)
description: Credit-linked subsidy for setting up new micro-enterprises in the manufacturing and service sectors.
benefits: 15%-35% subsidy on project cost (up to Rs. 50 lakh for manufacturing, Rs. 20 lakh for service units)

name: Stand-Up India
description: Bank loans between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore for setting up a greenfield enterprise.
benefits: Composite loan covering 75% of project cost, with a moratorium and repayment up to 7 years

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free loans up to Rs. 10 lakh for non-farm income-generating micro and small enterprises.
benefits: Loans under three categories: Shishu (up to Rs. 50,000), Kishor (up to Rs. 5 lakh), Tarun (up to Rs. 10 lakh)

name: PM SVANidhi
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Micro-credit facility for street vendors to resume and grow their livelihoods.
benefits: Working capital loan up to Rs. 50,000 in progressive tranches, with interest subsidy

name: National SC/ST Hub Scheme
description: Support for SC/ST entrepreneurs to participate in public procurement and access credit facilitation.
benefits: Handholding support, credit facilitation, and capacity building for SC/ST-owned enterprises

name: Mahila e-Haat
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Online marketing platform for women entrepreneurs, artisans, and self-help groups to showcase products.
benefits: Free online listing and direct market access without intermediaries

name: Annapurna Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development / State Governments
description: Loans for women to set up food catering and small food businesses.
benefits: Loan up to Rs. 50,000 for utensils and working capital, repayable in 36 installments

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
description: Financial assistance for proof of concept, prototype development, and market entry for early-stage startups.
benefits: Grant up to Rs. 20 lakh and investment up to Rs. 50 lakh through incubators

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
description: Collateral-free credit guarantee cover for loans extended to micro and small enterprises.
benefits: Guarantee cover up to 85% of the loan amount for loans up to Rs. 2 crore

name: National Handicapped Finance and Development Corporation (NHFDC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Concessional loans for persons with disabilities to start self-employment ventures.
benefits: Loans up to Rs. 30 lakh at concessional interest rates (3%-8%)

name: National Minorities Development & Finance Corporation (NMDFC) Scheme
description: Concessional financial assistance for income-generating activities for minority communities.
benefits: Term loans and micro-finance at concessional rates for minority entrepreneurs

name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Equity/quasi-equity support for SC entrepreneurs building scalable businesses.
benefits: Venture capital funding between Rs. 1 crore and Rs. 15 crore per project

name: Venture Capital Fund for Backward Classes
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Equity support for OBC entrepreneurs to scale viable business ideas.
benefits: Venture capital assistance for eligible OBC-owned enterprises

name: Udyogini Scheme
description: Subsidized loans for women from low-income households to start small businesses.
benefits: Loan up to Rs. 3 lakh with subsidy for women below a specified income threshold

name: Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Yojana (Youth Self-Employment)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Support for educated unemployed youth to set up self-employment ventures.
benefits: Project support up to Rs. 2 lakh with subsidy for eligible youth
